rules.heading: JUPITER IN LEO AND MAGHA NAKSHATRA

planetary.freeform: Jupiter in the sign of Leo, or in the Navamsha of Leo when the Sun is in Aries. Some say Jupiter in Leo is defective and to be rejected only in the year with Magha nakshatra on Pauranmasi in Magha month.

rules.notes: Jupiter in Leo is generally auspicious under certain conditions, though some restrict it when coinciding with Magha nakshatra on the full moon of Magha.

rules.heading: AVOIDANCE OF THE PERIOD FOR PERFORMING AUSPICIOUS DEEDS WHEN JUPITER IS IN THE SIGN OF CAPRICORN OR WHEN HE IS IN HIS FALL

planetary.freeform: Jupiter in Capricorn or in his fall. Permitted in regions east of Reva, west of Gandaki, north and south of Sonbhadra; avoided in Konkana, Magadha, Gaur, and Sindha regions.

rules.notes: Jupiter in Capricorn (his fall) restricts auspicious deeds in specific regions, but is acceptable in others, and only the lowest 5 degrees may need rejection according to commentary.

rules.heading: THE ILPTA SAMVATSARA AND ITS AVOIDANCE IN PERFORMING AUSPICIOUS DEEDS
rules.notes: Auspicious deeds should be avoided when Jupiter is in Atichara (accelerated motion), though the text cuts off.
